name: Zhicheng AI
summary: Zhicheng AI is a Hangzhou robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in March 2024. It develops embodied AI models and humanoid robot platforms, including bipedal and wheeled systems. Its XR1 wheeled humanoid is presented for factory material handling and other repetitive industrial work, while its TR series addresses broader robot manipulation and mobility applications.
